intermediate_failure_causes: A malformed standardisation entry reached .get on a string instead of being rejected as an invalid centre.

An empty canonical identifier was parsed as the plausible-looking id "nan" by the CSV reader, so the empty-identity guard never fired; tables are now read without default NA coercion and null identifiers are rejected before casting.

duplicate node index or canonical id
test_substitutes: synthetic four-node-type graph with one isolated lncRNA and one out-of-neighbourhood partner
synthetic omics evidence tables in tsv, csv and parquet form
fixed hidden size eight and a single HGT layer so the propagation check runs on CPU
scope_limit: Multi-omics node channels now enter the typed graph encoder instead of only the decoder. A validated evidence pair (table plus SHA256-pinned manifest, cohort or subject scope, frozen standardisation, clipped) becomes one value/observed column pair per declared channel for every node type; cc_hhgt/gnn.py widens the node input from the two historical degree columns to 2 + 2*channels and builds both encoder kinds at that width, while a bundle without a block keeps exactly two columns so every existing checkpoint still loads. The graph layer refuses a missing node-type block instead of zero-filling it, refuses stale identifiers, inconsistent widths, non-finite values, double attachment and a model built before augmentation. Fixture checks show a mutation value written on a gene node changes a connected lncRNA embedding through message passing while isolated and out-of-neighbourhood nodes stay bit-identical. The acceptance requirement set is now C01-C21: C17 is verified here, C18 (before/after multi-omics comparison) C19 (patient-level P-inactivation conditioning) C20 (mediation) and C21 (novel binding/PPI discovery with held-out evaluation) stay open. No optimizer, real cohort, paid compute or deployment ran, and no claim is made that multi-omics conditioning improves any prediction.
